# orion node

Any item or group

```sh
orion node <command> [options]
```

## orion node show

Show one item or group

```sh
orion node show [id] [options]
```

| Argument | Description                                                                               |
| -------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `[id]`   | Item or group id, or a selector such as label:"Extract slider", ref:jira:ABC-12, or pr:86 |
| `--json` | Print JSON                                                                                |

## orion node query

Find cards and groups with an expression

```sh
orion node query [options]
```

| Argument           | Description                                                                                 |
| ------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `--where <value>`  | Expression selecting cards or groups (required)                                             |
| `--sort <value>`   | Fields to sort by, separated by commas, such as status,-label; a leading - sorts descending |
| `--offset <value>` | Matches to skip before printing                                                             |
| `--limit <value>`  | Most matches to print                                                                       |
| `--all`            | Include done items                                                                          |
| `--json`           | Print JSON                                                                                  |

## orion node find

Find cards and groups whose label, note, or refs contain text

```sh
orion node find [options] [text...]
```

| Argument          | Description                              |
| ----------------- | ---------------------------------------- |
| `[text...]`       | Text to find, matched case-insensitively |
| `--limit <value>` | Most matches to print (default 20)       |
| `--all-canvases`  | Search every canvas, not only this one   |
| `--json`          | Print JSON                               |

## orion node remove

Remove items. Removing a note reconnects the links that ran through it

```sh
orion node remove [options] [ids...]
```

| Argument                | Description                                                                                            |
| ----------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `[ids...]`              | Item ids or selectors                                                                                  |
| `--where <value>`       | Select targets with an expression instead of ids                                                       |
| `--dry-run`             | Preview changes and current revision without writing                                                   |
| `--if-revision <value>` | Write only if the document has this revision                                                           |
| `--json`                | Print JSON                                                                                             |
| `--reconnect`           | Also reconnect cards with at most one incoming and one outgoing link; every selected card must qualify |

## orion node move

Move items or groups into another group

```sh
orion node move [options] [ids...]
```

| Argument                | Description                                          |
| ----------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------- |
| `[ids...]`              | Item or group ids or selectors                       |
| `--where <value>`       | Select targets with an expression instead of ids     |
| `--dry-run`             | Preview changes and current revision without writing |
| `--if-revision <value>` | Write only if the document has this revision         |
| `--json`                | Print JSON                                           |
| `--to <value>`          | Destination group                                    |
| `--top`                 | Move to the top level                                |
